condition: Recurrent acute pancreatitis without gallstones or alcohol (hypertriglyceridaemia)
summary: 36-year-old man with a third episode of acute pancreatitis; no gallstones on ultrasound, denies alcohol excess, triglycerides 18 mmol/L.

inputs.hpi: Third episode of pancreatitis in two years: epigastric pain through to the back with vomiting since last night. Recurrent pancreatitis. Denies alcohol excess. Type 2 diabetes, poorly controlled.

imaging.name: US abdomen
imaging.result: No gallstones. Normal CBD. Pancreas obscured by bowel gas.

mustInclude.note: Recurrent pancreatitis without gallstones or alcohol: check triglycerides (ACG 2024: > 1000 mg/dL causes pancreatitis), IgG4 and pancreatic imaging.

guideline.name: American College of Gastroenterology guidelines: management of acute pancreatitis
guideline.citation: Tenner S et al. Am J Gastroenterol 2024;119:419-437

rationale: The zebra check should offer the idiopathic-recurrent-pancreatitis causes when gallstones and alcohol are recorded as absent.
